subject: Req: HSM operator separation, ceremony minutes & telemetry samples (SOC2/SIG)
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@brightbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: audit@brightbank.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: HSM operator separation + ceremony minutes + telemetry samples (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Markus,

We're preparing BrightBank's SIG intake and the SOC2 auditor has also asked for a small package specific to key custody controls. Can you provide the following items by 2026-11-05?

1) Minutes from the most recent HSM key ceremony (including attendees, roles, and signature blocks).
2) Short operator separation-of-duties matrix (who is authorized to perform operator actions versus admin actions).
3) Sample telemetry extract showing HSM operator sessions (one week sample) — we only need anonymized operator IDs and session timestamps.
4) A brief note describing ephemeral wrapping (how ephemeral envelope keys are generated and discarded).

If any of the items include PII or internal usernames, please propose a redaction plan. Also note any transfer method constraints — we prefer SFTP with in-flight encryption and a transfer password.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Security Engineer, BrightBank

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@brightbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator separation + ceremony minutes + telemetry samples (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Lisa,

Thanks for the clear list — we can deliver. High-level plan:

- We will provide the HSM ceremony minutes (redacted where needed) and an operator SoD matrix by 2026-11-03.
- Telemetry: Ben will export a one-week session sample and apply irreversible pseudonymization to operator identifiers; timestamps will be left intact.
- Ephemeral wrapping: I will prepare a 1-page explanation and include a short schematic of the envelope lifecycle.

Attachments: redaction_plan_v1.pdf (outline for fields to be scrubbed) and sftp_instructions.md (how to provision an SFTP account and our public key).

Can you confirm: 1) SFTP hostname (we'll push to your inbound), or 2) if you prefer an encrypted Drive share? Also confirm whether you need operator names mapped to job IDs (we can provide role-level mapping only).

Markus Klein
Head of Compliance Engineering
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stubs: redaction_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 14KB), sftp_instructions.md (text, 3KB) ---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@brightbank.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator separation + ceremony minutes + telemetry samples (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Lisa — quick technical follow-up on telemetry.

Planned export:
- Scope: HSM operator session logs from 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24 (one week).
- Fields: pseudonymized_operator_id, session_start_utc, session_end_utc, action_type (login, key_load, key_export_attempt, logout), hsm_node_id.
- Pseudonymization: we will truncate usernames and append a consistent hash per operator for traceability inside the sample. No cleartext usernames will be included.

Delivery options:
- Option A (preferred): Secure SFTP push to audit@brightbank.com inbound (we'll provide host and SSH key).
- Option B: Encrypted Drive folder (we will password-protect the zip and share the password via a separate channel).

I can prepare a CSV sample (telemetry_sample_export_20261025.csv) with synthetic values for your initial review if that helps.

Ben Carter
Senior Security Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment stubs: telemetry_sample_export_20261025.csv (CSV, 28KB) ---

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@brightbank.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: audit@brightbank.com, SFTP Admin <sftp.admin@brightbank.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: HSM operator separation + ceremony minutes + telemetry samples (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks, Markus and Ben. A couple clarifications before you assemble the package: 

- For the ceremony minutes: we need attendee roles (operator, auditor, witness) and a signed confirmation that no key material left the HSM during the ceremony. Full operator names can be redacted — but include job title and employee ID if possible.
- For the SoD matrix: can you include a short narrative of how your internal approval workflow prevents a single person from performing an operator action and then exporting key material? A diagram is fine.
- Telemetry: the pseudonymization approach sounds good — please include a short appendix (2-3 bullets) describing the hashing method and salt handling.

Also: to speed transfer approvals, please have an internal point-of-contact listed on the transfer request and have the SFTP admin (cc'd) confirm inbound account creation once you push. We will also expect a short NDAs/TSAs where required — I'm attaching a DocuSign link for a standard secure-transfer rider.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/secure/ExampleDocuSignLink

Deadline still 2026-11-05? That works for us.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Lisa

CC: Irene (for the ceremony notarization artifact) and Marissa (for compliance indexing). If you need anything else, let me know — we can prepare a scoped operator identity mapping under an additional NDA if required.

Regards,
Markus Klein
